description: Verify that TCP does NOT change state on receiving an unacceptable RST in SYN-RCVD (RFC 793 §3.4 p33)
approach:
[Objective]
Negative companion of UNACCEPTABLE_01: a RST whose seq is outside the expected window cannot be authenticated → DUT must ignore it and stay in SYN-RCVD.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT in LISTEN.
2. Tester → DUT: SYN → DUT → Tester: SYN,ACK (SYN-RCVD).
3. Tester → DUT: unacceptable RST (out-of-window seq).
4. Observation: DUT must NOT emit RST.

[Pass condition]
No DUT RST after unacceptable RST.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_timeout_first_synack — first SYN,ACK missing
• Fail_unexpected_rst — DUT mistakenly emitted RST

verdicts.Pass: DUT ignored unacceptable RST in SYN-RCVD — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout_first_synack: No DUT SYN,ACK to first tester SYN
verdicts.Fail_unexpected_rst: DUT emitted RST after unacceptable RST
